title: Generative AI Beyond Tokens: Quantum Resource Consumption of IQP Circuits
summary: Quantum generative modelling casts sampling as a generative task: a parametrised quantum circuit is trained such that sampling reproduces a target probability distribution. Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits combine structural simplicity with complexity-theoretic evidence for quantum advantage. Yet their practical value depends not only on expressivity, but on how efficiently they consume genuinely quantum resources.
